title: BIZRA Impact Settlement Contract v1.0
description: How verified contribution becomes value without drifting into compute aristocracy. Token issuance is tied to receipt-bound impact, not hardware ownership. This contract protects the 8B-human mission from wealth concentration.

settlement_principles.principle_1: No contribution becomes value until it becomes a verified receipt.
settlement_principles.principle_2: Token issuance rewards verified useful impact, not raw hardware ownership.
settlement_principles.principle_3: A phone user who contributes verified high-quality knowledge earns more BLOOM than a workstation that generates unverifiable bulk output.
settlement_principles.principle_4: The Adl invariant (Gini ≤ 0.35) is enforced at the settlement layer, not just at the network layer.
settlement_principles.principle_5: Compute aristocracy is a constitutional violation. Settlement rules must prevent hardware wealth from becoming governance power.

contribution_classes.description: How different types of contribution are valued. Ordered by civilization impact, not compute cost.

knowledge_contribution.description: Human shares verified knowledge that improves the collective intelligence.
knowledge_contribution.example: A teacher contributes domain expertise that improves routing for thousands of future missions.

governance_contribution.description: Human participates in constitutional governance (voting, review, dispute resolution).
governance_contribution.example: Community member reviews and validates a constitutional amendment proposal.

compute_contribution.description: Node contributes verified compute cycles to the resource pool.
compute_contribution.example: NODE0 serves Agent-as-a-Service inference for weaker nodes. Earns SEED, not BLOOM.
compute_contribution.anti_aristocracy_note: Deliberately lower multiplier. Compute is commodity. Knowledge is civilization.

tool_contribution.description: Node provides specialized tool access (MCP servers, databases, APIs).
tool_contribution.example: A node with medical database access serves verified medical information queries.

personal_only.description: Mission was local-only. No network contribution. No settlement.
personal_only.example: User asks PAT a private question. Privacy preserved. No tokens involved.

rule_1_receipt_bound.rule: No SEED or BLOOM is issued without a URP Canonical Receipt.
rule_1_receipt_bound.enforcement: Settlement engine rejects any claim not linked to a valid receipt_id with URP signature.

rule_2_impact_not_volume.rule: Rewards scale with verified quality, not output volume.
rule_2_impact_not_volume.enforcement: BLOOM is proportional to impact_score in the receipt, not to token count or response length.
rule_2_impact_not_volume.rationale: Economic Impossibility Theorem: token-based revenue creates verbosity incentive (r=0.05). Quality-based revenue creates excellence incentive (r=1.00).

rule_3_anti_sybil.rule: One human, one constitutional identity. Duplicate nodes sharing one human reduce rewards, not increase them.
rule_3_anti_sybil.enforcement: Asabiyyah score (A15) detects coordinated behavior. Gini throttle applies sigmoid dampening to concentrated earnings.

rule_4_zakat_floor.rule: 2.5% of all SEED holdings above nisab threshold are redistributed to the network treasury annually.
rule_4_zakat_floor.enforcement: Automatic at protocol level. Not optional. Islamic finance invariant.
rule_4_zakat_floor.rationale: Prevents wealth accumulation from exceeding the Adl invariant over time.

rule_5_no_debt_creation.rule: The system may never create debt instruments, interest-bearing loans, or leveraged positions.
rule_5_no_debt_creation.enforcement: Interest-Debt Impossibility Theorem enforced at protocol level. RIBA_ZERO kernel invariant.
rule_5_no_debt_creation.rationale: Debt-based incentives create extraction loops that violate the 8B-human mission.

rule_6_mudarabah_sharing.rule: When URP provides compute assistance (Agent-as-a-Service), rewards are shared between the contributing node and the URP pool using Mudarabah (profit-sharing) ratios.
rule_6_mudarabah_sharing.enforcement: Receipt contains both local_contribution and urp_contribution fields. Settlement splits proportionally.

rule_7_waqf_endowment.rule: A fraction of all network BLOOM is directed to the Waqf endowment — permanent public goods funding for education, infrastructure, and constitutional maintenance.
rule_7_waqf_endowment.enforcement: Automatic at settlement. Waqf funds are irrevocable and governed by network consensus.

anti_aristocracy_gates.description: Mechanisms that prevent compute-wealthy nodes from dominating governance or economics.

gini_throttle.mechanism: Khaldunian sigmoid dampening on earnings concentration
gini_throttle.threshold: Gini > 0.35 triggers progressive reward reduction for top earners
gini_throttle.invariant: Network Gini must converge below 0.35 over any 365-day window

governance_weight_cap.mechanism: No single node may hold more than 1% of total governance weight regardless of compute contribution

newcomer_convergence.mechanism: New nodes must reach median earning capacity within 13 months
newcomer_convergence.evidence: 548-day simulation demonstrated convergence from 0.7429 to 0.1185 Gini with 13-month newcomer convergence

contribution_diversity_bonus.mechanism: Nodes that contribute across multiple classes (knowledge + tools + governance) earn a 1.15x multiplier over single-class contributors
contribution_diversity_bonus.rationale: Encourages well-rounded participation, not single-dimension optimization

settlement_record.description: The settlement record attached to each URP Canonical Receipt after impact evaluation.

gini_at_settlement.description: Network Gini at the moment of settlement

zakat_deducted.description: Zakat amount if applicable (0 if below nisab)

mudarabah_split.description: Profit-sharing split if URP provided assistance. Null if local-only.

settlement_hash.description: BLAKE3(receipt_id + impact_score + seed_issued + bloom_issued + settled_at). Append-only ledger entry.
